title: [review] coap_oscore.c: encode_content_format_option unused-function warning when LICHEN_COAP_SERVER_OSCORE=n
description:
Found by 3x codereview pass 3/3 (edge-cases) on uncommitted coap_oscore.c changes (worker2 round 2026-09-09).

lichen/subsys/lichen/oscore/coap_oscore.c:110 defines encode_content_format_option unconditionally, but its only call site (coap_oscore.c:167) is inside #ifdef CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_SERVER_OSCORE (coap_oscore.c:133). The file compiles whenever CONFIG_LICHEN_OSCORE=y && CONFIG_COAP_SERVER=y (lichen/subsys/lichen/oscore/CMakeLists.txt:23-25), while LICHEN_COAP_SERVER_OSCORE is a plain bool default y that may be set n (lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/Kconfig:84-88). That combo yields GCC/Clang -Wunused-function under Zephyr -Wall (not fatal; project does not set COMPILER_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS).

Fix: wrap the helper in #ifdef CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_SERVER_OSCORE, or move it inside the protected block of coap_oscore_respond_resource.
close_reason: Already fixed at HEAD by 97396e874a (fix(coap): CF option on OSCORE-protected responses) — the landed commit wraps encode_content_format_option in #ifdef CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_SERVER_OSCORE (coap_oscore.c:102-128), exactly the remediation this bead proposed. The finding was filed against the pre-commit working tree; by the time it was claimed the owner had committed the guard. Verified HEAD state directly; no further change needed (my duplicate-guard edit was reverted).
